deck_context.source_summary: Class29, week6, September24 2026. Traditional AEM Sites, local Author SDK. English slide images, Spanish guide. No homework, no speech or PPTX.
canonical_facts: Request resolvers preserve caller access and are owned by Sling. Factory-created service resolvers are owned by the application and must be closed.
Mapping uses actual calling bundle symbolic name plus subservice to a bracketed list of service-user principal names. Mapping grants no repository permissions.
Demo uses wknd.core:training-guide-read=[training-guide-reader], fixed /content/training-permissions/guides, resource-based read ACL from lesson28, no arbitrary HTTP path or elevated servlet.
Principal-based login does not expand group memberships; give intended privileges directly to mapped principals. Resource ACL and principal-based login are different dimensions.
Demo OSGi service reads only the fixed folder and returns a detached String inside try-with-resources. LoginException differs from a null resource. No SDK execution is claimed.
CSRF protection is an HTTP-layer check for protected write requests, not a replacement for ACLs. Do not disable filters or fall back to admin.

Mapping and ACL solve different problems.
Close owned resolvers; keep borrowed ones open.
